mapper.sql: A.delivery_id, A.customer_id, A.order_id, A.order_node_id, A.delivery_status, A.create_time, A.create_by, A.update_time, A.update_by
mapper.select: SELECT o.delivery_address address, o.order_remark remark, c.customer_name customerName FROM brt_sales_order o left join brt_customer c on c.customer_id = o.customer_id where o.order_id = #{orderId}
update brt_order_materiel_plan set materiel_num = materiel_num+#{deliveryRemindVo.thisNum} where plan_id = #{deliveryRemindVo.planId}

SELECT ifnull(omp.materiel_num,0) fulfillNum, -- 已送货数量 ifnull(omp.order_num,0)-ifnull(omp.materiel_num,0) surplusNum -- 剩余数量 FROM brt_sales_order so inner join brt_customer_delivery cd on cd.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_sales_order_details sod on sod.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id and omp.order_node_id = cd.order_node_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}

SELECT so.order_no orderNo, so.delivery_time deliveryTime, -- 计划送货日期 c.customer_name customerName, -- 客户名称 so.order_remark remark, -- 备注 so.delivery_address address, -- 送货地址 so.order_time orderTime, so.contact FROM brt_sales_order so inner join brt_customer_delivery cd on cd.order_id = so.order_id left join brt_customer c on so.customer_id = c.customer_id where so.order_id = #{orderId} limit 0,1

SELECT ifnull(m.materiel_name,omp.materiel_id) materielName, -- 产品名称 sod.materiel_unit unit, -- 单位 ifnull(omp.order_num,0) detailsNum, -- 销售数量 sod.details_remark remark, -- 备注 sod.details_price price, -- 单价 sod.details_amount amount, -- 总价 m.materiel_spec spec FROM brt_sales_order so inner join brt_customer_delivery cd on cd.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_sales_order_details sod on sod.order_id = so.order_id inner join brt_order_materiel_plan omp on omp.order_details_id = sod.details_id and omp.order_node_id = cd.order_node_id left JOIN brt_materiel m on m.materiel_id = omp.materiel_id left join brt_customer c on so.customer_id = c.customer_id where so.order_id = #{orderId}
